subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: May OpenClaw accept `@microsoft/mxc-sdk@0.7.0`, its transitive native `node-pty` build allowance, packaged MXC executables, and the SDK's base64 argv config transport for this first-party prerelease MXC sandbox plugin?
rationale: This is a native sandbox/security-boundary decision with supply-chain and process-visibility impact that cannot be resolved by deterministic code review alone.

options.title: Approve current prerelease plugin
options.body: Approve the exact head after secops review, rerun dependency guard, and document that the SDK argv transport is accepted for this prerelease plugin.

options.title: Pause for upstream transport
options.body: Keep the PR open until the MXC SDK exposes a non-argv config transport or a narrower secret-safe launch contract.

options.title: Move outside first-party release
options.body: Do not merge this package into the OpenClaw repo until native dependency ownership and security acceptance can be handled in a separate owner channel.

recommendation.title: Approve current prerelease plugin
recommendation.body: Approve the exact head after secops review, rerun dependency guard, and document that the SDK argv transport is accepted for this prerelease plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed the package ownership, dependency approval, and security-review expectations that match the remaining blocker.
